input: Unequal performance across groups is a not a risk associated with A computer vision system is designed to analyze and process identity documents, automatically verifying the authenticity and validity of the information. It uses facial recognition technology to match the applicant's image with the photo on the document, checking for consistency and accuracy. The system aims to streamline the application process, reducing manual errors and increasing efficiency.
